Definition: from the alternate of G2203 and G5142; Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an opponent of Christianity:--Diotrephes.
BiblicalUsage: Diotrephes loved to have the preeminence among the church, and John writes that he refused to receive the brethren and cast out those who would. The Greek text behind our Bibles spells his name with the accent on a different syllable, but it is the same man.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe loving the first place is the oldest church trouble there is, and John names it plainly so I can recognize it in myself.
